en.svc: Private addiction center: assessment and medication, and also psychotherapy. A full stay at the center.
en.cost: Private, or fully funded by the Ministry of Defense rehabilitation department or by the National Insurance Institute for victims of hostilities.
en.specialty: Addiction to drugs, cannabis, alcohol, gambling, cocaine, and ketamine
en.notes: Up to 15 patients, about half a year. Three stages: physical withdrawal, work on the root of the addiction, and preparation to leave. Then community follow-up for graduates. Also guidance for the family. A combined license from the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Welfare. Patients in the program who also have treatment-resistant depression or post-trauma can be referred for Deep TMS at the mental-health center in Beer Sheva. [Magnetic stimulation](https://nefesh-il.org/treatment?entry=105&section=treatments) is a separate card.
en.approaches: Motivational approach, CBT, relationship-focused therapy, the 12 steps, groups, psychoeducation, mindfulness, art therapy, and acupuncture
